title: Raw Listening Observation v1
description: Local Android capture record. This is not the backend ingestion payload.

eventId.description: Random UUID assigned to one accepted local observation.

observerSessionId.description: Random per-listener-connection grouping identifier; not a user or device ID.

eventTimeMs.description: Device wall-clock milliseconds sampled when TuneMind accepts the callback.

savedAtMs.description: Device wall-clock milliseconds sampled by the local repository before insertion; null before saving.

trackId.description: Directly reported MediaMetadata media ID; provider-specific.

durationMs.description: Directly reported nonnegative MediaMetadata duration in milliseconds.

playbackStateCode.description: Raw Android PlaybackState.STATE_* integer; null when PlaybackState is unavailable.

positionMs.description: Last position reported in PlaybackState; not continuously updated or estimated.

positionUpdateElapsedRealtimeMs.description: Source-reported PlaybackState.lastPositionUpdateTime on Android elapsed-realtime clock; not TuneMind callback time.
